title: Engagement Celebration
description: Red and black, kept deliberately simple. A single-tier cake iced with a shell border and lettered “she said yes” stands on a mirrored riser over red linen, with champagne poured behind it. The long table works the same palette in texture — black rosette linen, pillar candles in clear cylinders, and deep red roses laid loose along the eucalyptus.
